entries.title: A new engine and match client
entries.body:
✨ What's new
• Open MTG Arena now runs on a much larger rules engine and match client, adopted from an open-source project (see NOTICE).
• Tens of thousands of cards, parsed from their rules text. A card the engine can't fully handle is marked unsupported.
• Play against the AI in Standard, Modern, Pioneer, Legacy, Vintage, Pauper and Commander, with tournament deck lists bundled for the AI.
• Everything runs in your browser and works offline once loaded. No accounts, no servers, no online play.
